notes: Archetype-driven POI distribution. The element<->content inversion is DERIVED from StretchCapabilities.CONTENT_CAPABILITIES (single source of truth, no duplication) — this file holds only the survival/variant element mappings and solver-neutral ambient richness knobs. Ambient richness is presentation, never a substitute for increased causal difficulty. A 'crucial element' is the content-suppliable capability an archetype's shadow approach requires; coverage guarantees every archetype in a stretch has its element placed, and a shared element (one needed by several archetypes) is placed ONCE (merge).
